name: l6-tunnel-hatch
note: PO 10-20 #64 "let me be able to close them to lock Zombies out": the north maintenance hatch at x162 (camera side, beside the barrier pier) closed by the courier at the start of the retreat. Look for: frame 2 hatch shut with the yellow drop bar across it; frames 150-400 the leaf jolts on each bash (one per second after the bang) while nobody comes through; frame 590 (after 8 bashes) the leaf hangs open and the two arrivals walk out toward the courier. Walls, walkway and hatch readable in the dark.
